display_long_description:
Free demo version of the first two bosses of the game!

Swing Hard VR is A Dark Fantasy Boss Rush game inspired by Dark Souls x Thrill of The Fight, that will give you a real workout! 
Don't just git gud with your fingers, git fit with your whole body!

# Features

- Several bosses each with their own unique fighting style, special moves, and mechanics. 

 - Multiple weapons. Swing with Axes or punch and elbow with unique weapon "Claw Shields" or stab precisely with a Spear.

 - Damage based on how fast you swing. You can't just wiggle the controller to do damage like other VR games. 

 - You have to move your body to dodge! Duck, Sway, Dash, and even Jump to avoid damage. 

 - Multiple difficulty modes. Including customizable difficulty allowing you to even change animation speed of bosses. 

 - Dark story, what unholy power has corrupted humans into monsters? Can it be harnessed for good? 

 - If space is limited use unique "Squat to move mechanic" to reposition where you can use joystick to move but it requires squatting down in real life, ensuring a workout!

# WORKOUT GUARANTEED!



## Credits


Songs: 

Noire Antidote, Mathilde Nobel - Dysphonia

Mellow Sonic - Gravitational Singularity (Xanomeline Remix)
